About the game
Many intense duels and journeys through feudal Japan await you. There will be plenty of dangers and, of course, mystical forces. As for sword counterstrikes, they have become much more comfortable and precise, making battles even more dynamic.

Here you are a skilled warrior who, by chance, finds himself drawn into a fight against dark forces. His home village has been destroyed, and it was none other than evil demons who did it. Therefore, the hero has no choice but to uncover the dark conspiracy and find loyal allies.

Features of the game

The ability to create combos from attacks and counterattacks Non-linear narrative and various allies A fairly detailed feudal Japan

Installation:
1. Download the folder anywhere (make sure the folder path has Latin characters only).
2. Run "Onimusha2.exe".

Add-ons:
- Orchestra Album Selection Pack
